normalized.description: Migrate a brain from gbrain-base (or any pack) to gbrain-base-v2's 14-canonical-type taxonomy via gbrain onboard --check + the unify-types Minion handler. Collapses 94 noisy types to 15 canonical with subtypes, alias rows, and link rows. Triggers when an agent notices pack_upgrade_available, type_proliferation, or asks "what is the canonical taxonomy / how do I clean up my page types".
normalized.name: schema-unify
